item.title: [ZEPPELIN-2463] Avoid Locking interpreterSettings during Notebook deletion
item.description:
Deletion of a notebook requires locking interpreterSettings. If the deletion is delayed , then lock is not released. At that point, we cannot run any notebook because everything is waiting to lock interpreterSettings.

Looking at the code, there is no reason to lock the InterpreterSettings object in InterpreterSettingManager.removeNoteInterpreterSettingBinding.
Similarly in InterpreterSettingManager.getNoteInterpreterSettingBinding only interpreterSettingBinding is accessed and its already a thread safe object. So we can remove synchronization on InterpreterSettings

More details in comments

comments.comment:
Here is the scenario:

I removed a running note. The stack trace for the thread handling note removal is as below:

        at java.lang.Object.wait(Native Method)
        at java.lang.Thread.join(Thread.java:1249)
        - locked <0x00000000ff20bdd0> (a org.apache.zeppelin.interpreter.InterpreterGroup$1)
        at java.lang.Thread.join(Thread.java:1323)
        at org.apache.zeppelin.interpreter.InterpreterGroup.close(InterpreterGroup.java:204)
        at org.apache.zeppelin.interpreter.InterpreterGroup.close(InterpreterGroup.java:169)
        at org.apache.zeppelin.interpreter.InterpreterSettingManager.removeInterpretersForNote(InterpreterSettingManager.java:808)
        at org.apache.zeppelin.interpreter.InterpreterSettingManager.removeNoteInterpreterSettingBinding(InterpreterSettingManager.java:900)
        - locked <0x00000000c0398950> (a java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap)
        at org.apache.zeppelin.notebook.Notebook.removeNote(Notebook.java:334)
        at org.apache.zeppelin.socket.NotebookServer.removeFolder(NotebookServer.java:1069)

As you can see, it is holding InterpreterSettings object (0x00000000c0398950)
But it is stuck waiting to close the session in a remote Interpreter.
Unfortunately, it never comes out of this wait.

When I try to run any note, they try to lock InterpreterSettings object (0x00000000c0398950) ,
Now all these threads have to wait till the removal thread releases the lock on
0x00000000c0398950 which it will never do.

To show that there is no progress in this scenario , I have taken thread dump at two different times
